about: D1-D5: reward rows and broken reward items

entries.why: Eldritch (40) and Enchanter (41) are cloth-only but got only the leather Kedger's Gilded Boots; period: 'If you can't wear leather armor ... he gives you Kedger's Quick Boots' (Allakhazam Criofan's Fish; Quick Boots citem 4364 are cloth) - they now use the row that also gives the cloth Quick Boots, like Mentalist
Ranger and Nightshade keep the leather Kedger's Gilded Boots; Eldritch/Enchanter moved to the Quick Boots row (20936)

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 5154 'Silver Reinforced Vest' (Wayback 2004-09-29): Torso, Armor Factor 78, Absorb 19, Dex 6, Cha 6, Matter 10%, Body 10%
entries.why: Crace's Desire reward for Blademaster/Bard/Ranger had Object_Type 0 and AF 0 (not armour); period item is reinforced with AF 78 / ABS 19 (bonuses already match)

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 8837 'Lute of the Harpers' (Wayback 2004-05-25): Slot Two Hand, Instrument Type: Lute, Requires Skill: Instruments
entries.why: Bard reward had Object_Type 0, so it was no instrument; eObjectType.Instrument is 45 and DPS_AF holds the instrument type (lutes are 2, like dyrwood/ebonwood lutes)

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 2606 'Flute of Angus Og': Two Hand, Instrument Type: Flute, Requires Skill: Instruments (Bard)
entries.why: The West Wind reward had Object_Type 0 (no instrument); flutes are Object_Type 45 with DPS_AF 3 (as carved/dyrwood flutes); listed in part07 D3 'same defect outside the slice', no other part owns it

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 4099 'Flute of Displacement' (period capture 2003-10-03): Two Hand, Instrument Type: Flute, Requires Skill: Instruments (Minstrel)
entries.why: Scura Tragedia reward had Object_Type 0 (no instrument); flute = Object_Type 45, DPS_AF 3; listed in part07 D3, no other part owns it

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 6572 'Onyx-tipped Cat o' Nine Tails' (Wayback 2003-10-20): Right Hand, Requires Skill: Flexible Weapons (Reaver), Slash, DPS 9.5, Delay 3.7
entries.why: Reaver reward had Object_Type 0 (no weapon skill or styles); Flexible is Object_Type 24 (DPS 95 / SPD 37 / slash already match the period page); listed in part07 D3, no other part owns it

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 29051 'Mystical Faerie Ring': Requires Class: Animist, Eldritch, Enchanter, Mentalist (quest Catch of the Day)
entries.why: Animists got no reward although the period Mystical Faerie Ring is made for Animists; they now take the Eldritch row that gives it
Animist (55) moved to the Mystical Faerie Ring row 20948; Valewalker stays on the no-item row because no period ring of this quest allows Valewalkers

entries.source: Allakhazam quest Missing Tapestry: 'Lilerbad's Beads of Parrying -- Hero, Blademaster, Paladin and Reaver (co-op)', 'Lilerbad's Beads of Strength -- Mauler'; item citem 9400
entries.why: Hero got the Mauler-only Beads of Strength; period gives Heroes the Beads of Parrying

entries.source: Allakhazam quest Missing Tapestry: 'Lilerbad's Beads of Thought -- Animist, Valewalker, Enchanter and Mentalist'
entries.why: found while checking D5: no Missing Tapestry row allowed Enchanter (41) or Eldritch (40), so they could not take the quest at all; Enchanter gets the period Beads of Thought, Eldritch the same INT caster beads (the walkthrough names no Eldritch item)
